solution.name: Layered Module with Protocol-based Engine + Rule DSL
solution.summary: Full PRD implementation: MA/MACD/KDJ/BOLL indicator engine + cross_over/cross_under/gt/lt/and/or rule DSL + T+1 backtest engine + Service/API/DB + Frontend page with config form, equity curve, trade table. Backend assigned to Codex, Frontend to Gemini.

implementation_plan.approach: Mirror existing backtest module architecture with new strategy_backtest namespace. Backend-first (Codex) enabling parallel frontend work (Gemini).

tasks.name: Backend: Data Models & DB Tables
tasks.key_point: Add StrategyBacktestRun, StrategyBacktestTrade, StrategyBacktestEquity ORM models in storage.py. Pydantic request/response models matching PRD section 7 JSON. No alembic - use Base.metadata.create_all like existing tables.

tasks.name: Backend: Indicator Engine (MA/MACD/KDJ/BOLL)
tasks.key_point: Pure functions. Each indicator takes DataFrame+params, returns DataFrame with indicator columns. Reference stock_analyzer.py for MA/MACD patterns. Implement KDJ/BOLL from standard formulas.

tasks.name: Backend: Rule Engine
tasks.key_point: Parse rule expressions (cross_over, cross_under, gt, lt, and, or). Evaluate against indicator columns. Return boolean signal series.

tasks.name: Backend: Backtest Engine
tasks.key_point: Protocol-based pure engine. Day-by-day: indicators -> rules -> signals -> T+1 trade execution -> equity tracking. Single position long-only.

tasks.name: Backend: Service + Repository + API
tasks.key_point: Service: data fetch + indicator calc + engine run + persist. API: POST /run, GET /history, GET /{run_id}. Register /api/v1/strategy-backtest router.

tasks.name: Backend: Unit Tests
tasks.key_point: Indicator correctness, rule edge cases, full backtest with synthetic data.

tasks.name: Frontend: Types + API Client
tasks.key_point: TypeScript interfaces. API functions: runStrategyBacktest, getRunHistory, getRunDetail. Follow api/backtest.ts pattern.

tasks.name: Frontend: Strategy Backtest Page
tasks.key_point: Config form (indicator params, rule builder, stock/date/cash) + results (metric cards, equity curve, trade table). Register /strategy-backtest route.

tasks.name: Frontend: Chart + Components
tasks.key_point: EquityCurve: recharts line chart. TradeTable: sortable. RuleBuilder: dropdown-based condition builder.

implementation_plan.execution_flow: T1 + T2 (parallel) -> T3 -> T4 -> T5 + T6 (parallel) -> T7 -> T8 -> T9

technical_concerns: KDJ/BOLL have no existing code reference - implement from standard formulas
Rule expression parsing for nested and/or conditions needs careful AST design
recharts needs to be added to package.json
DataFetcherManager DataFrame may have NaN for insufficient history periods

agreements: Layered architecture pattern (Engine -> Service -> Repository -> API)
KDJ/BOLL must be implemented from scratch
Frontend: Tailwind dark theme, no component library, Chinese UI
T+1 execution model to avoid look-ahead bias
Independent module from existing AI backtest
consensus.resolved_conflicts: PRD requires configurable rules with cross_over/cross_under/gt/lt/and/or. Go with full DSL.

constraints: Backend implementation assigned to Codex CLI tool
Frontend implementation assigned to Gemini CLI tool
Final review by Claude + Codex together
Single stock, daily, long-only for MVP
Must not modify existing backtest module
No alembic migrations - use create_all pattern
